name: Recital 6
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text: Amendment As long as the emissions trading system for buildings, road transport and additional sectors is in place, the mechanism to limit excessive price increases must react effectively and automatically. If the price level referred to in Article 30h(2) of Directive 2003/87/EC is reached, a significantly higher amount of allowances should be released from the reserve without delay. If the measure is triggered twice during the same 12-month period, the additional release should also occur twice in full. Priority must be given to limiting disproportionate heating, mobility and operational costs for households and businesses.
